title: The Ghost Ship SS Baychimo
hook: In 1931, an ice-trapped cargo ship was abandoned, then kept sailing for decades.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Trapped in Arctic ice, the crew was rescued, leaving the ship behind.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The abandoned ship was reportedly spotted still drifting a year later.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Sailors said they boarded her once, finding cargo still perfectly intact.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Reported sightings continued for nearly forty years across the frozen north.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: Most historians now think the derelict eventually broke apart or slowly sank unseen.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: No wreck has ever been found, so officially, her fate is still unknown.

end.line: Could the Baychimo still be drifting somewhere?

description: Abandoned in Arctic ice in 1931, the cargo ship SS Baychimo was reportedly spotted drifting, empty, for decades. Nobody knows how or when it finally disappeared.

facts.claim: The SS Baychimo was a Hudson Bay Company cargo steamer trapped in Arctic ice off Alaska in October 1931 and abandoned by her crew.
The ship did not sink; it was reboarded briefly by local Inuit trappers soon after being abandoned.
Over the following decades, the empty ship was reportedly sighted drifting in the Arctic by various sailors and explorers.
The last widely reported sighting was in 1969, nearly forty years after it was abandoned.
No wreck of the Baychimo has ever been officially located or confirmed.
Most researchers believe the ship eventually sank or broke apart in the ice, though exactly when and where remains unknown.
